{"sections":{"overview":"Conveyor cell that moves parts to an end station where a pneumatic pusher pushes each part off onto a take-away table. About 10 parts per minute.","sequence":"- Start (panel pushbutton or HMI) runs the conveyor.
- When a part reaches the end photo-eye, stop the conveyor and extend the pusher.
- When the pusher-extended prox turns on, retract the pusher and restart the conveyor.
- Count every part that reaches the end.","safety":"- One E-stop on the operator station, dual channel into a safety relay. Safety relay output to the PLC as Safety OK.
- Loss of Safety OK stops the conveyor and retracts the pusher (stop category 0).","guarding":"","homing":"","modes":"Auto only. Stop button (NC) or HMI Stop ends the cycle.","motion":"M1 conveyor motor, 1 HP, 480 VAC 3-phase, across-the-line contactor and overload.","pneumatics":"Pusher cylinder, single 5/2 solenoid valve (spring return), pusher-extended prox. Retracts when the valve is off.","sensing":"- Part-at-end photo-eye, PNP.
- Pusher extended prox, PNP.","operator":"- Operator station: Start (green), Stop (red, NC), E-stop.
- 7" C-more HMI: Main screen with Start/Stop/Reset, running and fault lamps, part count with reset; Alarms screen; I/O status screen.","alarms":"- Pusher fault: pusher not extended within 3 s. Latches; Reset (panel Start or HMI Reset) clears it when the pusher is back.","utilities":"480 VAC 3-phase, 60 Hz. NEMA 12 enclosure. Plant air 80 psi.","other":""},"questions":["How many parts per minute at most?"],"summary":"Organized the description into sections."}
